title: 報稅表
mood: your year turning out to be a few boxes
subject: a twenty-five-year-old's first tax return and the hour a mother spends explaining it
caption: Cantonese narrative pop led by glitch production. The vocal itself chopped and stuttered mid-phrase as a rhythmic device, a deep sub bass, a soft drum machine with clipped hi-hats, small glitch clicks and skips punctuating the lines, a warm pad under the chorus. Glitch-edited and intimate with a heavy sub and plenty of space for the words. Male voice, conversational and storytelling, lightly edited and stuttered rather than autotuned. 108 BPM, D minor. Finding out your whole year is a few boxes on a form. No live band, no trap hi-hat rolls, no rap, no big ballad climax, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
報稅表 寄到嚟 啡色信封 我放咗喺枱面三個禮拜
每次經過 我都望佢一眼 佢都望返我
今晚我終於打開 第一頁 我已經唔識
「應評稅入息」 我讀咗四次 都係唔明

[Chorus]
報稅表
我廿五歲 第一次 同政府講我搵幾多錢
原來我嘅一年 係幾個格仔
填完 好細 細到我有啲唔開心

[Verse]
我打畀阿媽問 佢即刻話「我教你」
佢逐格講 好慢 好耐心
佢以前每年都幫阿爸填 我都唔知
原來佢識咁多我唔知嘅嘢

[Chorus]
報稅表
我廿五歲 第一次 同政府講我搵幾多錢
原來我嘅一年 係幾個格仔
但阿媽講嘅嗰一個鐘 唔使填 都好大

[Outro]
